coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Edgewater
record.summary: A six-story, 193-unit rental apartment building at 355 Berry Street on Mission Creek in Mission Bay North. DataSF's Assessor tax roll (block 8707, lot 003) records the building's construction year as 2007.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I/II/III, Madrone, Arden, One Mission Bay, Radiance).

The 2005 construction permit's own unit count (194) is one more than the Assessor's 193 -- likely a manager's unit counted differently between filing and final tax-roll record, not a different building; not further reconciled here.
